content.comment_body: Hello, I have two sets of [product_name] and [product_name] communication modules. The first unit measures the tank level through an analog input. I want to send this value to a second unit once daily, and have it output that value via its analog output. Is this achievable with [product_name], or would it require a [version_no] controller without additional hardware such as [product_name]? Best regards, [user_name]
Check out this example from [company_name]: It covers communication between two [product_name] controllers using [product_name] modules and SMS messaging.

Thank you for your reply. This matches what I want to achieve. However, I'm curious how to do this using only one analog sensor, with the analog value being sent from the first unit and output through the analog output of the second unit. The provided example appears to use multiple sensors and digital inputs instead.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are considering how to use SMS communication with [product_name] controllers and modules to transfer analog values between devices, specifically capturing an analog input from one controller and sending the data to another for analog output. There is uncertainty regarding the capability to send analog values using SMS, since available examples focus on digital signals. The discussion includes interest in whether [version_no] controllers could enable this without extra modules.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to transmit an analog value using SMS between two [product_name] devices, allowing the receiving unit to reproduce the value at its analog output, and hope to achieve this setup with only one analog sensor involved.
